component.title: AttachmentPreview
component.purpose: An honest, resilient attachment surface that keeps each file understandable through upload, scanning, success, and recovery.

states.description: Per-file progress and cancellation keep an active transfer understandable.
A completed attachment keeps its preview and file actions.
A failed transfer names the problem and offers a real retry path.

claims.statement: The attachment communicates upload, scanning, success, and request-error states without implying an adapter action occurred.
Progress is associated with the individual file and remains accessible through a named progressbar.
Actions and recovery copy reflow into a readable narrow layout without document overflow.
